datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2019, classifying geographic units in Mozambique into food insecurity phases. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing the current situation assessments across different scenarios and time periods.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity phases across geographic units in Mozambique.
